messages:
alejandra: Hey team — customer acct_92X reporting negative credit balance after a chargeback + refund. They say their $50 promo didn’t reapply after a dispute reversal (invoice inv_2026-0199). Getting billing_required / 402 on embeddings. Can we triage?

mike: Ack, can you DM me the full acct + invoice + tx ids? I’ll pull ledger rows.

alejandra: Sent via DM: acct_92X, inv_2026-0199, chargeback cb_778, refund rf_779. Screenshot link: https://redwood.s3/xxxx

billing-bot: Note: Refund webhook received from payments at 2026-03-12T14:21:03Z for rf_779. Processing status: queued.

rachel: I’m looking. I see refund + promo reversal triggered clawback of promo credits, but user balance shows -$12.50 still. Initial logs hint reversal may have been applied twice. Investigating.

mike: I repro'd by replaying webhooks in staging — there’s a race: refund webhook processed before promo finalization, reconciliation retried and ended up inserting a second reversal row. We need idempotency on reversal processing.

alejandra: Customer hits 402 on embeddings endpoint and "insufficient_credits" in UI. They also tried to reapply promo via dashboard and got a 500.

rachel: Dashboard 500 is separate (N+1 causing timeout) — ENG ticket ENG-5147 opened. For this account I can push a manual credit of ~$13 to zero out negative and pause automatic clawback for this promo until we patch. Need approval.

oncall-eng: Saw related timeouts from verify-ledger job at 14:23Z; reconcile job retried and seems to have created duplicate reversal rows. Log excerpt: \n```\nERROR reconcile: duplicate ledger reversal for tx rf_779 user acct_92X pid 563\nDB query: INSERT INTO ledger_reversals (user_id, tx_id, amount, reason) VALUES (...)\n```\n
mike: Proposed rundown: 1) billing-ops manual top-up $13 (temp) 2) run DB dedupe to remove duplicate reversal row rr_9001 3) deploy webhook idempotency fix (PR #2389) 4) notify customer + waive any downtime impact. Thoughts?

billing-ops: Can do manual top-up after CS approval and we have the ticket number and timeline. Will also coordinate ledger dedupe during low-traffic window.

alejandra: CS approves manual fix — ticket CS-9421 created and customer consented to manual adjustment. Patch ETA for idempotency ~3 hours.

rachel: Manual credit of $13 applied and held from clawback. Reconciler dedupe script run; duplicate reversal removed. Balance now at $0. Customer emailed refund summary. :white_check_mark:

alejandra: Customer confirmed embeddings requests now succeed, no more 402. They want a root cause summary — I’ll send one: race between refund webhook processing and promo finalize causing duplicate clawback; fixed via dedupe + idempotent reversal handler.

oncall-eng: Added alert to payments pipeline for "duplicate reversal detected" and bumped reconcile job timeouts. Deployed PRs #2389 and #2397 to prod.

mike: Closing loop — billing adjusted, ENG deploys live, CS notified customer. Follow-up retro scheduled. :thumbsup:
